2607.05177.title: CP-WSP: A Declarative CP-SAT Framework for Configurable Multi-Constraint Workforce Scheduling
2607.05177.paper_summary: Workforce scheduling is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and operational objectives. Existing CP formulations typically model simplified instances with 6-12 constraints at shift-level granularity and critically lack explicit support for: mandatory break scheduling with midpoint placement control; acuity weighted workload equity; sub-shift temporal granularity enabling demand-driven staffing; inter-week schedule stability; and cross-midnight shift patterns common in 24-hour operations. This paper presents CP-WSP: a declarative CP-SAT framework enforcing 14 hard constraints as mathematically inviolable requirements (zero regulatory violations by construction) while optimizing 15 soft objectives through a unified weighted penalty function -- all configurable via a JSON specification with no code changes required. Key contributions include: a shift-window variable decomposition enabling mandatory break scheduling with centrality control; acuity-weighted workload equity; multi-granularity temporal resolution from 30 minutes to 2 hours; inter-week schedule stability; a grid-offset preprocessing technique for cross-midnight shifts; and a reproducible 36-configuration benchmark suite for community comparison. Evaluated on INRC-II benchmarks at both hourly and shift-level granularity and on 36 synthetic configurations.
2607.05177.paper_summary_zh: 勞動力排班是一個 NP-hard 的組合優化問題，需要同時滿足勞動法規、覆蓋要求、員工偏好和運營目標。現有的 CP 公式通常建模簡化的情況，具有 6-12 個約束條件，並在班次級別的細節上嚴重缺乏明確的支持：強制休息排程與中點放置控制；根據嚴重程度加權的工作量公平；允許需求驅動的排班的子班次時間粒度；跨週的排班穩定性；以及在 24 小時運營中常見的跨午夜班次模式。本文提出了 CP-WSP：一個聲明式的 CP-SAT 框架，強制執行 14 個硬約束作為數學上不可侵犯的要求（通過結構保證零違規），同時通過統一的加權懲罰函數優化 15 個軟目標——所有配置均可通過 JSON 規範進行，無需代碼更改。主要貢獻包括：一種班次窗口變量分解，實現強制休息排程與中心性控制；根據嚴重程度加權的工作量公平；從 30 分鐘到 2 小時的多粒度時間解析；跨週的排班穩定性；一種針對跨午夜班次的網格偏移預處理技術；以及一個可重複的 36 配置基準套件，用於社區比較。在 INRC-II 基準上進行評估，涵蓋每小時和班次級別的粒度，以及 36 個合成配置。
